{{Quote|Anyway, if Obi-Wan is right and that rabble was hired to prevent us from continuing with our mission, their employer would have kept those who attacked us in the dark as to his or her identity and purpose. Even if we had been successful in capturing one of them, an interrogation might well have been useless.|Luminara Unduli regarding their attackers|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
This '''Wetakk''' was part of a group of individuals on [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] that [[First skirmish in Cuipernam|attacked]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contingent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> One of his arms was severed by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], but it simply transferred its hooked weapon to another hand and continued fighting.<ref name="AS" />
